corrections.summary: Editorial same-version correction merged in Brand-Context-Protocol/spec#35. Records that GARM was discontinued, makes the derived suitability tiers optional, permits voice/tone projection only as direct copies of structured voice.md values, and adds an AdCP note checked against schema 3.2.9. RFC 0019 is a separate draft in the spec repository and adds no normative requirement. The version stays 2.0.0.
